hold_text: CFI-NET-OPEN-TRADES (manager 28a dispatch). Alert-only runtime monitor (src/runtime/closed_flat_invariant.py); no order path, no flatten, no config. Both degrade to the previous behaviour when the columns are absent. why: Stop false 'closed in DB but open on venue' alerts when an open DB trade owns the venue position, while still alerting on a real residual.
